name: Progress Bar / Circle
summary: Read-only progress primitive with determinate Bar/Circle, Bar-only Indeterminate, and independent visible and accessible value text.

anatomy.name: labelText
anatomy.description: Visible operation label inside the label row.

anatomy.name: value
anatomy.description: Optional compact visible value for Bar.

anatomy.name: circleText
anatomy.description: Optional compact visible value for Circle.

states.name: determinate
states.description: Known current value within a declared range.

states.name: indeterminate
states.description: Unknown completion value; available only for the bar presentation.

behavior.name: progressbarSemantics
behavior.description: Determinate progress requires a non-empty operation name, a strictly increasing finite range, and a finite current value clamped within that range; invalid required composition emits no root.

behavior.name: indeterminateSemantics
behavior.description: Indeterminate Bar omits aria-valuenow, aria-valuetext, and visible value text; the consumer's updated region owns authoritative aria-busy state.

properties.name: accessibleLabel
properties.description: Accessible name for the operation whose progress is represented.

properties.name: value
properties.unsetBehavior: Omitted only while indeterminate is true.
properties.description: Current determinate value, clamped by the target to the declared range.

properties.name: max
properties.description: Maximum determinate value; must be greater than min.

properties.name: displayValue
properties.description: Optional intentionally compact visible value for determinate Bar or Circle; it is not derived from valueText.

properties.name: valueText
properties.description: Optional complete localized accessible value description for determinate progress; maps only to aria-valuetext and is not displayed.

properties.name: indeterminate
properties.description: Uses unknown-duration Bar motion and omits numeric and textual determinate values.

accessibility: Use progressbar semantics for determinate progress.
Expose a complete localized valueText through aria-valuetext only when it helps users interpret the raw value.
Keep optional displayValue compact and intentionally authored for the available Bar or Circle geometry; do not derive it from valueText.
Do not copy, truncate, scale, or fall back between displayValue and valueText.
Keep max greater than min and clamp the current value to the valid range.
Do not announce frequent progress updates too aggressively.
Respect reduced-motion preferences for indeterminate animation.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition in components/css/primitives.css.
